title: daphne tangutica var. wilsonii
intro: Daphne tangutica var. wilsonii, commonly known as Wilson's Daphne, is a flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine, particularly in Tibetan and Chinese traditional medicine, due to its health benefits and therapeutic actions. Wilson's Daphne is believed to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving pain, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents present in Wilson's Daphne include daphnetin, a lignan with potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
